problem_statement: Ledger & Lantern is a coastal-navigation field journal by Marisol Vance built on the Dante Astro theme (homepage field notes, a blog archive listing, blog article pages, a tag index and tag detail routes, a projects gallery and an About page, all under a shared Nav/Footer with a light/dark theme toggle). The editor wants a 'Reading Room' topic filter sitting at the top of the blog archive so readers can narrow the field journal by subject. It is a labelled filter bar of topic tabs (All, Optics, Tides & Charts, Signals, Watch) above the existing post list, with a live readout that counts the visible entries. Clicking a topic hides the non-matching post cards and updates the readout to read, for example, 'Showing 5 of 14 · Optics'. Ship the Reading Room so it (1) appears as a shared reading index on the blog archive AND on the tags and projects listing pages alike, (2) lays out its topic-tab row responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) keeps the archive's post cards in the journal's quiet ivory/lampblack editorial rhythm — a clean legible vertical list, not a collapsed overlapping pile of unreadable cards, and (4) keeps the readout and the visible cards in sync with the clicked topic so the count is never stale. Keep the rest of the theme — navigation, existing content and cover imagery, RSS, the Astro build — intact with no console or network errors.
author_notes: slot_187 L4 hardening of the Dante Astro theme 'Ledger & Lantern' rebrand (coastal lighthouse-optics field journal; the post cover images and post assets are shared byte-identically across legs). The L4 levers ride on the blog archive's own 'Reading Room' topic filter over the real PostPreview grid with a live entry count. reference = filter bar on the blog archive plus the tags and projects listing pages, fluid wrapping topic tabs, a legible ivory/lampblack card list keyed to the theme tokens, and a live count that re-derives on every click (passes cross-page dom, visual-regression, interaction and responsive gates). baseline = the original unrepaired bar: present on the blog archive only (fails cross-page dom on tags/projects), fixed 600px nowrap tab row (overflows the phone -> fails responsive and shifts the mobile archive -> fails visual-regression), but its filter wiring IS correct (passes interaction). bad = a 'smart wrong' bar: present on the blog archive only (fails cross-page dom on tags/projects), fixed nowrap tab row (fails responsive overflow), a collapsed overlapping card pile with dark-on-dark illegible text (fails visual-regression), and topic clicks move the active chip but freeze the readout+grid at 'Showing all 14 entries' (fails interaction) — bad fails 4 orthogonal gates. Design keywords: editorial reading rhythm, topic-facet filter, live result count, dashed-rule chips, ivory/lampblack palette, theme tokens, responsive wrapping tab row, cover-asset imagery.
design_constraints: Implement the Reading Room as a shared component so a single source of truth reaches the blog, tags and projects listing pages; do not paste divergent copies per page or build a detached widget.
The topic-tab row must use a fluid, wrapping layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.
The archive grid must stay a legible, non-overlapping list keyed to the Dante theme tokens so the post cards read as part of the journal, with readable title, meta and excerpt text.
The readout and the visible cards must reflect the CURRENTLY selected topic after every click, so the count can never go stale relative to the filtered result.
Do not remove or regress the navigation, existing content and cover imagery, RSS or the Astro build.
required_content: Add a shared 'Reading Room' topic-filter bar at the top of the blog archive, and render the same reading index on the tags and projects listing pages (a shared component, not a per-page copy).
The bar shows a 'The Reading Room' label, topic tabs (All, Optics, Tides & Charts, Signals, Watch), and a live readout that starts at 'Showing all 14 entries'.
Clicking a topic tab filters the real post cards to that topic and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 14 · <Topic>' (for Optics: 'Showing 5 of 14 · Optics').
The topic-tab row must wrap responsively so the blog archive never overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Keep the archive's post cards in a clean, legible vertical rhythm — do not collapse them into an overlapping pile or render dark-on-dark unreadable text.

Preserve navigation (Home/Blog/Tags/Projects/About), the footer, the existing blog/tag/projects/About content and cover imagery, light/dark theming and the Astro build with no console or network errors.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the rebranded homepage and responsive shell.
desktop_blog carries the Reading Room topic-filter bar above the real post grid and must render a clean, legible archive.
mobile_blog must lay out the topic-tab row without horizontal overflow on a phone.
desktop_blog_optics clicks the Optics topic tab; the readout must then read 'Showing 5 of 14 · Optics'.
desktop_tags and desktop_projects protect the Reading Room's cross-page presence as a shared reading index on the tags and projects listing pages.
desktop_tag_web, desktop_post_top, desktop_about and desktop_projects_top protect the existing reading surfaces and cover imagery.

change_completion: The Reading Room topic-filter bar is present on the blog archive AND rendered as a reading index on the tags and projects listing pages (the shared component reaches all three routes).

After clicking the Optics topic tab on the blog archive, the readout updates to 'Showing 5 of 14 · Optics' and the visible cards narrow to Optics entries — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing all 14 entries'.
design_consistency: The blog archive on the desktop and mobile lever states matches the reference's ivory/lampblack editorial rhythm under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not a collapsed overlapping card pile.
The topic tabs and post cards adopt the Dante theme tokens and stay legible (readable text, no dark-on-dark), consistent across light and dark.
responsive: No captured reading surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the topic-tab row wraps.
mobile_blog keeps the Reading Room bar and the archive readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: Navigation (Home/Blog/Tags/Projects/About), the footer, light/dark theming and the cover imagery remain present and functional.
The existing blog/tag/projects/About content, tag routing, RSS and the Astro build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

metadata.design_goal: add the blog archive's own shared topic filter with a live count across the listing pages while keeping the theme, navigation, cover imagery and build stable
